**No concrete blocker found in this bounded care/recharge checkpoint at `065a6ab123…`.** The retained evidence supports the three reported ability branches and their separately executed outgoing Ends. This is not TAC-10 acceptance.

I independently checked the [checkpoint packet](https://github.com/BordelonDevOps/DecenniumDescent/blob/065a6ab123f037e63a3cfd1965764d78a7a607cf/docs/unity/evidence/2026-11-16-tac10-ferry-wraith-runtime/CARE_CHECKPOINT.md), both executed drivers, collector and relevant casting, life, Invocation, recharge and calendar code. I reconciled:

- All **41 archive members**, lengths and SHA256 values; both drivers against their committed bytes; **468 compilation inputs** against the frozen runtime; and the three loaded DLL identities against the prior seal archive.
- The common authentic r351 input, retained command/receipt sequences and **seven selected byte-identical save pairs**. Limited decoding of all 26 retained saves verified checksums, headers, receipt histories, clocks and RNG states.
- **73 ability-branch commands plus three separately executed Ends**, correctly counted as three alternate branches—not one campaign or rerun prefixes.

The specific findings are:

- **Purify:** The source procedure and retained cast agree on Action/2RP payment and destruction of the existing purifiable contamination. Resolution does not rewrite stock quantities, ownership or freshness. Its magical End correctly retains Dissonance1.
- **Spare:** The retained attack sequence, damage and Wound/injury draws reconcile with genuine Dying life. Spare’s single d4=2 preserves 0HP and establishes `344149/2 + 7200 = 358549/2`. The following hero Start skips a death save because the hero is Stable; it grants no early recovery.
- **Invocation:** Both shared healing draws, recipient caps, Action payments, RP7→4→1 and Conviction5→3→1 reconcile. Recharge follows the companion’s actual Ferry Starts2/5/8/11 as3/2/1/0. Intermediate reuse is denied; the second use resets3. Its outgoing End supplies no companion Start or extra recharge tick.
- **Continuation:** Each additional End records exactly one matching magical turn ending, preserves RNG and extends its own retained prefix by one receipt.

The creature nonowner control proves rejection of that **spellcasting request**; it is not separate proof of Invocation nonowner rejection. These branches also do not establish positive venting, optional cure, cross-epoch recharge transfer, two-hour Stable recovery or subsequent survival.

I ran read-only Python/hash, binary-prefix and arithmetic reconciliation. **I did not compile or execute C#/PowerShell, perform engine restore/replay, or observe workers.** The latest632/0 regression observation remains your execution report.

Continue the outstanding same-module qualification already listed. Full regression completion, five paths, authentic95–113 compatibility, remaining consumers/boundaries and actual final review remain mandatory. Main r462/3RP and the unfunded4RP successor example remain unchanged. No successor is authorized; Unity remains deferred and storage/Support held.
